  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R08 is the only triggered rule, making Linkage the sole adverse family. The home-address exception does not apply because the address was registered recently. No earlier outcome settles this order. Under §6.6(b), Linkage required id_check; it passed, satisfying every required check. Section 5.3(a) therefore requires clear and prohibits further hold, decline, escalation or needs_check. A shared household is the strongest benign explanation; address linkage alone does not establish coordinated fraud. No installment was due, so non-payment cannot support an adverse recommendation. Clear the unshipped order; no further check is needed."
